result.title: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
result.summary: Relative-position attention mechanisms offer compelling alternatives to RoPE across various transformer architectures, delivering superior performance in domains such as audio. These mechanisms typically modify attention scores by adding content-position or bias-position terms. Unlike RoPE, which encodes position via per-token rotations directly on the queries and keys, relative-position terms generally require pairwise offset-dependent computation or lookups, complicating their integration into fused attention kernels and introducing severe memory, bandwidth, and compute overheads as sequences scale. To address this bottleneck, we propose an exact attention algorithm that incorporates additive relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style tiled computation. Our method (1) uses offset-aware tiling to avoid redundant indexing and memory accesses, (2) computes only the necessary key/query-relation products and reuses them across token pairs in both forward and backward passes, and (3) uses offset-based gradient sharding and aggregation, eliminating atomic contention. We provide a unified, efficient Triton implementation across diverse relative-position attention mechanisms and evaluate it against naive and specialized implementations. For 8K-token sequences, our method speeds up the forward (backward) pass by 1.8-6.4$\times$ (2.0-21$\times$) and reduces peak memory up to 2.9-128$\times$ (1.4-54$\times$) over the strongest baseline for each mechanism, enabling long-context end-to-end transcription that is 1.8$\times$ faster and uses 2.4$\times$ less memory. Our method thus provides a drop-in, hardware-efficient solution for scaling relative-position attention transformers.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种把加性相对位置项并入 FlashAttention 式分块计算的精确注意力算法，通过偏移感知分块、关系积复用与基于偏移的梯度分片，实现跨多种相对位置机制的 Triton 实现，显著加速并降低长序列显存占用。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作属于注意力核函数与显存/带宽优化，虽涉及位置偏置与长上下文成本，但不触及 latent 状态、视觉证据、推理决策或训练监督，与 LVR 的状态表示和推理机制无实质联系。
